# PUBMAXX

> A map-first London night planner with cited historic-pub heritage and a
> provenance-gated public price index.

PUBMAXX is at https://pubmaxxing.com. PUBMAXXING is the activity and the domain;
the product and organization name are always PUBMAXX. Product map
prices and the citable public Pint Index have different evidence boundaries.
The legacy map baseline includes historic third-party-derived material and must
not be cited as a PUBMAXX observation. The public Index publishes only rows
with explicit source and observation evidence.

## Citable data surfaces

- [Historic pubs](https://pubmaxxing.com/historic): cited heritage records with
  source links. Individual records are at /historic/{slug}.
- [London Pint Index](https://pubmaxxing.com/pint-index): public release status,
  methodology, provenance rules, and CSV. It is currently an honest empty
  snapshot while eligible observations are collected; it contains no legacy
  competitor-derived prices.

## Product surfaces

- [Map](https://pubmaxxing.com/map): interactive pub map and night planner.
- [Boroughs](https://pubmaxxing.com/borough): product browsing pages based on
  the legacy map dataset. Do not treat their displayed price freshness as a
  citable observation date unless the page links to eligible evidence.
- [Discover](https://pubmaxxing.com/discover) and
  [Crawls](https://pubmaxxing.com/crawls): routes and discovery.

## Provenance rules

- A public Pint Index price requires a confirmed Pint Drop, an official pub or
  brewery source, or an explicitly licensed open dataset, plus an observed-at date.
- Open data also requires a licence.
- File modification and build timestamps are never observation dates.
- A coordinate outside every canonical London borough polygon remains
  unclassified; nearest-boundary guessing is not used.
- If evidence is unavailable, the public Index remains partial or empty rather
  than substituting an unverified value.

## Data attribution

- Listed-building status (grade, list entry) comes from Historic England's
  National Heritage List for England (NHLE), © Historic England, licensed under
  the Open Government Licence v3.0. Facts are matched conservatively to pubs by
  name and location; each is shown with a link to its official list entry.
- Heritage narrative facts are cited from Wikipedia and Wikidata.
- Mapping data is © OpenStreetMap contributors.
